title: Part 6: One More Ride With Rick

series.summary: Morty returns home, and Rick wakes him for one last ride into another adventure.

cuts.voiceover_text: Morty is finally asleep. Then Rick appears in the doorway wearing a motorcycle helmet. He leans over the bed, and Morty barely has time to process what is happening. A moment later, Morty is sitting behind Rick on a motorcycle. Rick says he fixed the magnets and asks if Morty is ready to ride. Morty looks unconvinced, but he stays on. They blast into the night beneath a purple sky. Rick throws both arms up, grinning like this is perfectly normal. Morty starts terrified. Then he smiles. After everything, Rick is not sending Morty away. He is taking him into another adventure.
